name: web-fetch
description: Fetch a URL and return its content as markdown. Extracts article content from HTML pages using readability, converts to markdown preserving headings, links, lists, tables, and code blocks. Supports PDF text extraction. Truncates at 8,000 tokens.

content.description: The extracted content in markdown (HTML pages) or plain text (PDFs, text files).

tokenCount.description: Estimated token count of the content.
